reading:
T5 Data Centers has operated since 2008, per its own site tagline, Creating Forever On Data Centers Since 2008. The company's own About page does not state a headquarters address or current ownership structure, and no other source reviewed this session confirmed one, so headquarters is left unrecorded here rather than inferred from facility branding.

T5's leadership team is described as having collectively designed, developed, or operated more than 100 mission critical facilities across their careers, a combined-experience figure rather than T5's own current portfolio size. The company's site references facilities in Chicago and Elk Grove, Illinois, Charlotte, North Carolina, and Portland, Oregon, alongside a numbered T5@Atlanta campus series in Georgia, where trade press separately reports T5 announcing a 300 megawatt data center campus.

T5 was named alongside Infomart Data Centers as one of two asset sources IPI Partners drew on when forming STACK Infrastructure in 2019, a fact recorded in this registry's STACK Infrastructure entry. However, T5's own site remains active and distinctly branded, with no reference to STACK, indicating T5 continued operating independently after that transaction rather than being fully absorbed. This row is treated as a separate, currently operating company rather than a duplicate of STACK Infrastructure. The registry here tracks 3 T5 facilities across two states, Illinois and Ohio.

sources.title: Data Center Dynamics, T5 announces 300MW data center campus in Atlanta, Georgia
